workflow_metadata.description: Updates Salesforce opportunities after meetings by extracting deal details, matching accounts, updating fields, logging the call, and sending a Zoom Chat confirmation.

nodes.node_desc: Start when a meeting event occurs, such as meeting start, end, or other activities.

input_map.task_prompt:
Get meeting data {{bgmenb.meeting}} to update salesforce opportunity .

if {{bgmenb.meeting}} is empty or not sales meeting, just skip immediately.

Output contract:
- Return only the configured output fields.
- name: updated Opportunity name, or empty string when skipped.
- url: Opportunity URL/link when available, or empty string when skipped.
- should_notify: true only when the Salesforce update tool completed successfully.
- result_json: a non-empty serialized JSON object with this shape:
{
  "status": "updated|skipped|failed",
  "skip_reason": "only when skipped or failed",
  "opportunity_name": "",
  "account_name": "",
  "account_industry": "Salesforce Account Industry field, empty string if unknown",
  "opportunity_id": "",
  "opportunity_url": "",
  "meeting_date": "meeting date formatted like 'Mar 19, 2026', empty string if unknown",
  "call_logged": true,
  "updated_fields": [
    {"field": "Stage|Amount|Close Date|Probability|Next Step|Other", "old_value": "Unknown", "new_value": "", "evidence": "brief phrase from meeting"}
  ]
}

Rules:
- Ground every update in the meeting data.
- Only include an entry in updated_fields when it has a real, concrete new_value that actually changed. Never include a field with an empty, unknown, or unchanged new_value just to report it was considered.
- Keep result_json compact; cap updated_fields at 6.
- If should_notify=false, result_json must still explain why in skip_reason.
- Never include markdown fences in any output field.

skills.name: salesforce_record_ops
skills.description: Creates, updates, reads, and deletes Salesforce records across standard and custom sObjects when the user asks for ordinary record CRUD with explicit object and field intent. Use for Lead, Account, Contact, Opportunity, Task, Campaign, Note, CampaignMember, and custom object record operations when the request is single-record or safely bounded. Do not use for metadata/schema setup, field creation, permissions, validation rules, reports, bulk jobs, raw org diagnostics, or high-level business workflows such as Lead conversion.

tools.description: Salesforce connector helps businesses manage and improve customer relationships, and enable sales pipeline automation.

tool_details.node_description: Retrieves information about the current user or a specific user in Salesforce.
Search for Salesforce accounts using multiple criteria like name, industry, type, location, or contact information.
Search for Salesforce opportunities using multiple criteria like name, account, stage, amount, close date, or status.
Search for Salesforce contacts using multiple criteria like name, email, phone, account, or title.
Creates a new opportunity in Salesforce with the specified information.
Logs a completed phone call as a task in Salesforce with call-specific details like duration, type, and disposition.
Creates a new note attached to a Salesforce record with the specified title and content.
Updates specified fields of an existing Salesforce Opportunity by its ID,the Opportunity must exist.
